description: PROVINCIA MONZA BRIANZA Strade Provinciali is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Lombardia. Il dataset (lineare) individua la rete stradale di proprietà della Provincia di Monza e della Brianza (proiezione planimetrica rappresentazione semplificata di svincoli e rotonde - 2° Livello) nel territorio della Provincia MB. Coverage: Regione Lombardia. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Lombardia. Its tags are brianza, monza, provincia, provincia-monza-brianza, provinciale. It offers 4 resource(s) in GEOJSON, KML, KMZ, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
